title: Themaric product price record
description: One file per product at /data/v1/products/{goods_no}.json. Olive Young public listing price of the representative option, last observation of each day (KST), observed 1-2 times daily. Excludes coupons and card-issuer discounts. Olive Young sometimes switches the representative option, so a single jump in this series is not by itself proof of a price change.

gtin13.description: GTIN-13 barcode of the representative option. Only set when unambiguous; null otherwise.

brand.description: Brand name as shown on Olive Young (usually Korean).

name.description: Product name as shown on Olive Young (Korean, not translated).

page_url.description: Human-readable verdict page on themaric.kr (Korean, with an English summary).

olive_young_url.description: Olive Young product page. Affiliate link (see disclosure) when olive_young_url_is_affiliate is true.

list.description: Listed regular price shown by Olive Young (the base of the displayed discount).

usual.description: Usual selling price over the observation period.

lowest_20d.description: Lowest actual selling price in the last ~20 days (Korean FTC 'prior transaction price' standard).

days_at_list_price.description: Days on which the listed regular price was actually charged, within days_window.

code.description: honest: The listed regular price was actually charged on a meaningful share of observed days. inflated: The listed regular price was rarely or never actually charged, so a discount computed from it overstates the saving. genuine: The current price is clearly below the highest price observed — a real discount. watch: No list-price problem detected; the verdict compares the current price with the usual selling price (at / above / below usual). sale_end: A recent discount has ended; the current price is higher than the recent price. raised: The listed regular price was raised during observation.
